decisions.copy: Redesign work for the age of AI agents. AI tools are spreading. Work still gets stuck in the same handoffs. Prism helps leadership teams build agent fluency, identify workflow bottlenecks, and create a governed operating model for human-agent work.

decisions.copy: AI tools do not make an organization AI-native. Most enterprises already have AI tools and pilots underway. But the structure of work often stays the same. That is not transformation.
